source_state: uncommitted immutable prediction resource inspection and completed scalar-backed unloaded slots
behavior: Architecture-owned immutable traversal enumerates physical modules with the same ordinals as parameter control and borrows actual retained model/pooling prototypes without cloning state. Every embedded prediction family implements it, including both DeepSeek-V4 sequential and DSpark variants.

Native prediction inventory includes inner values, unloaded placeholders, active parameter replacements, exact checkpoint source storage, weight-manager buffers and retained state prototypes. Replicated and composite sessions establish their resolved inspection fence first.

Completed scalar broadcasts preserve unloaded parameter shapes and dtypes while releasing lazy constructor graphs. Native CPU/Metal checks verify bounded backing without evaluating the original full-shape values. Invocation still binds exact checkpoint leases and replacements before execution.

Seven prediction variants across resident, host-layerwise and disk-streamed execution have certified inventory bounds. Hidden checkpoint directories cannot trigger reads during inspection. Nonzero replacements add their allocation once across prediction and target inventories; unevaluated replacements remain unknown without evaluation; restoration recovers the original bound.

Nonzero model/pooling prototypes are counted and aliased prototype buffers deduplicate. Inventory snapshots retain original allocations after executable destruction. Targets without prediction extensions supply an explicit empty prediction inventory in nine target configurations.

Neutral scoring/replay, state restore, module failure completion and inspection failure tests pass. Native CPU/Metal component captures, interventions, bounded speculative collectors, public activation admission, quantized prediction parameters and embedded schedulers retain their execution behavior.
limits: This milestone inventories retained prediction extension owners; it does not finish whole-request budget admission or shared enforced reservations.

Active prediction lanes, observer resources, escaped outputs, copies and enclosing request resources remain additional owners. Future execution, cache growth, materialization and preparation workspace require their enforced bounds.
An inventory itself retains its physical allocations and must be charged when combined with shared admission. It is not an allocation permit or residency-ledger pin.
Metadata, allocator caches, JIT and other process/system memory remain outside these managed-payload capacity facts. Unknown custom storage and unfinished arrays remain unknown.

The 21 prediction inventory configurations ran on CPU. Native execution regressions and placeholder checks ran on CPU and Metal. No new native multi-device distributed or CUDA validation was performed.
No new allocator/process peak measurements or released-checkpoint comparisons were performed. Earlier pinned Qwen numerical and peak records remain separate evidence.
The existing compact-unwind warning and unused inventory/quote helpers remain pending production admission composition.
